seoTitle: Email Domain Typo Fixer: gmial.com, hotmial.com and More
metaDescription: Fix common email domain typos such as gmial.com, hotmial.com, yahooo.com and .con in a pasted list, and review every change. Free and private.
intro: Paste addresses and see each domain correction before you import the list.
why:
Typed signups often contain domains like gmial.com or outlook.con. Those addresses bounce, and the person never gets your email. Correcting the obvious ones recovers real subscribers.

The fixes come from a built-in list of typos for big providers and common ending mistakes. Review the change list: a rule can be wrong for an unusual real domain. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Turn off applying fixes if you only want the report.

faq.a: Yes, rarely. That is why every change is listed.

faq.q: Can I add my own typos?
